title: Integer complexity of \(2^k3^\ell\)
statement: For all nonnegative k and ℓ, the integer complexity of 2^k3^ℓ equals 2k+3ℓ.

counterexample.description: A \(+\), \(\times\), and \(1\) expression for \(2^k3^\ell\) using fewer than \(2k+3\ell\) ones. The equality is verified for every \(\ell\) when \(k\le48\).
